<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="when-edits-take-effect"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#when-edits-take-effect">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">When edits take effect</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Claude Code watches your settings files and reloads them when they change, so it applies most edits to the running session without a restart, including edits to <code>permissions</code>, <code>hooks</code>, and credential helpers such as <code>apiKeyHelper</code>. Claude Code also loads a settings file you create mid-session if its folder existed when the session started. For the project’s <code>.claude/</code> folder, it loads the file even when you create the folder in the same session.</span>
<span data-as="p">The reload covers user, project, local, and managed settings, and Claude Code runs the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#configchange"><code>ConfigChange</code> hook</a> for each settings-file change it detects, not for managed settings that arrive from MDM or the claude.ai console. Managed settings that arrive through MDM or from the claude.ai console reach a running session on a schedule rather than on save; the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-settings#choose-a-delivery-mechanism">delivery table</a> gives it per source.</span>
<span data-as="p">Claude Code reads some keys only once, at session start, so an edit to one of them doesn’t reach the running session. Admin-side keys that also wait for a restart, such as <code>requiredMinimumVersion</code>, are listed under <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-settings#where-and-when-a-policy-applies">where and when a policy applies</a>. The ones you’re most likely to edit mid-session:</span>
<ul>
<li><a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#model"><code>model</code></a>: use <a class="link" href="/docs/en/model-config#setting-your-model"><code>/model</code></a> to switch mid-session. Each model has its own prompt cache, so the first request after a switch re-reads the whole conversation uncached; see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/prompt-caching#switching-models">Switching models</a></li>
<li><a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#effortlevel"><code>effortLevel</code></a> and <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#modelsettings"><code>modelSettings</code></a>: use <a class="link" href="/docs/en/model-config#adjust-effort-level"><code>/effort</code></a> to change effort mid-session</li>
</ul>
<span id="verify-active-settings"></span>
<span id="check-what-loaded"></span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="confirm-what-loaded"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#confirm-what-loaded">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Confirm what loaded</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Run <code>/status</code> inside Claude Code to see which settings sources are active. The <strong>Status</strong> tab includes a <code>Setting sources</code> line that lists each settings file Claude Code loaded for the current session, such as <code>User settings</code> or <code>Project local settings</code>. When <a class="link" href="/docs/en/admin-setup#decide-how-settings-reach-devices">managed settings</a> are in effect, the managed settings entry shows in parentheses how they reached your machine.</span>
<span data-as="p">The line confirms which files Claude Code read; it doesn’t show which file supplied each key. To list entries Claude Code rejected, run <a class="link" href="/docs/en/debug-your-config"><code>claude doctor</code></a>; for a model that project or managed settings set, the startup header names the file that set it. <code>/status</code> and <code>/config</code> open the same dialog on different tabs, and the <strong>Config</strong> tab isn’t a view of your <code>settings.json</code> contents.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="fix-a-broken-settings-file"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#fix-a-broken-settings-file">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Fix a broken settings file</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">If you mistype JSON or set a key to a value Claude Code doesn’t accept, Claude Code tells you at the start of an interactive session. What it shows depends on how much of the file is affected:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Settings Error</strong>: a user, project, or local file has invalid JSON or a value the schema rejects. At the start of an interactive session Claude Code shows a dialog that lets you fix the file with Claude’s help, exit, or continue without the broken settings.</li>
<li><strong>Settings Warning</strong>: only individual entries fail, such as a malformed permission rule or an unknown hook event name. Claude Code skips those values and keeps the rest of the file in effect.</li>
<li><strong>Managed settings</strong>: Claude Code keeps enforcing the rest of the file. <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-settings#invalid-entries-in-managed-settings">Invalid entries in managed settings</a> says what it drops and which keys fall back to a stricter value until you fix them. For a managed settings document that isn’t valid JSON, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/errors#managed-settings-document-could-not-be-parsed">Managed settings document could not be parsed</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Configuration error</strong>: <code>~/.claude.json</code> can’t be parsed. Claude Code copies the broken file to <code>~/.claude/backups/.claude.json.corrupted.&lt;timestamp&gt;</code> and asks whether to exit and fix it by hand or reset to the default configuration; a <code>-p</code> run prints the error and exits. To recover your previous state, copy back one of the five most recent <code>.claude.json.backup.&lt;timestamp&gt;</code> files in <code>~/.claude/backups/</code>, which Claude Code saves before it writes the file.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">After you continue, run <code>/status</code> to see the affected files and <code>claude doctor</code> for the details of each error.</span>
<span data-as="p">A <code>-p</code> run shows no dialog. Unless <a class="link" href="/docs/en/errors#managed-settings-document-could-not-be-parsed">a managed settings document can’t be parsed</a>, Claude Code skips the broken file or values and continues with the rest, so after a <code>-p</code> run that ignores a setting, run <code>claude doctor</code> to see what it dropped.</span>
<span id="how-scopes-interact"></span>
<span id="key-points-about-the-configuration-system"></span>
<span id="which-value-claude-code-uses"></span>
<span id="which-value-wins"></span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="settings-precedence"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#settings-precedence">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Settings precedence</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">When the same key appears in more than one place, Claude Code uses the value from the highest level that sets it. The stack below shows the levels, highest on top; a key at a higher level overrides the same key anywhere below it.</span>
<!-- -->
<span data-as="p">In order, highest precedence first:</span>
<ol>
<li><strong>Managed settings</strong>: settings your organization deploys, by a <code>managed-settings.json</code> file, an MDM policy, or <a class="link" href="/docs/en/server-managed-settings">server-managed settings</a> from the claude.ai console. Nothing you set overrides them: a key you pass with <code>--settings</code> doesn’t override the same managed key, and a flag such as <code>--model</code> picks only from the models your organization allows. A managed <code>model</code> sets the model each session starts with, and you can still switch with <code>/model</code>; the lock is <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#availablemodels"><code>availableModels</code></a>, which constrains <code>/model</code>, <code>--model</code>, and the <code>model</code> key in your own files. When your organization delivers more than one managed source, the rules for <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-settings#precedence-within-the-managed-tier">precedence within the managed tier</a> say what Claude Code reads from each.</li>
<li><strong>Command line arguments</strong>: flags you pass when you start <code>claude</code> from a terminal, for one session; see <a class="link" href="#change-a-setting-for-one-session">Change a setting for one session</a>. Claude Code merges JSON you pass with <code>--settings &lt;file-or-json&gt;</code> with your settings files by the same rules as the other levels: it takes a key you set here over the same key in local, project, or user settings, and keeps the lower-level value for a key you omit.</li>
<li><strong>Project local settings</strong> (<code>.claude/settings.local.json</code>): your personal settings for this project.</li>
<li><strong>Shared project settings</strong> (<code>.claude/settings.json</code>): settings your team checks into source control.</li>
<li><strong>User settings</strong> (<code>~/.claude/settings.json</code>): your personal settings for every project.</li>
</ol>
<span data-as="p">Environment variables aren’t a level in this stack. When a behavior has both a shell variable and a settings key, which one applies is decided per pair, not by level: <code>ANTHROPIC_MODEL</code> exported in your shell applies over the <code>model</code> key from any file, while <code>ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL</code> applies only when no file sets <code>model</code>. The <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars#precedence">environment variables reference</a> says which keys have a pair and which one Claude Code reads first. An <code>env</code> block inside a settings file is an ordinary key and follows the levels above.</span>
<span data-as="p">For a few security-sensitive keys, Claude Code honors a stricter value from a lower level over a managed value; <a class="link" href="#exceptions-to-managed-settings-precedence">Exceptions to managed settings precedence</a> lists them.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="lists-merge-instead-of-overriding"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#lists-merge-instead-of-overriding">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Lists merge instead of overriding</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">When you set the same list key, such as <code>permissions.allow</code>, in more than one file, Claude Code combines the lists instead of picking one, so each file can add entries without removing another file’s. Four keys that hold model lists or per-model entries follow their own rules:</span>
<ul>
<li><a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#fallbackmodel"><code>fallbackModel</code></a> is an ordered chain where position carries meaning, so Claude Code takes the whole value from the highest-precedence file that defines it.</li>
<li><a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#modelpicker"><code>modelPicker</code></a> holds one ordered list of rows plus a replace flag, so Claude Code never merges rows from two sources. It takes the whole value from the highest of managed settings, <code>--settings</code>, and user settings that defines it, and ignores the key in project and local settings. Requires Claude Code v2.1.242 or later.</li>
<li><a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#availablemodels"><code>availableModels</code></a>: when the managed settings Claude Code applies define it, Claude Code applies that list as-is and ignores entries you add in user, project, or local settings, unless an app that embeds Claude Code supplies its own model list; see <a class="link" href="#exceptions-to-managed-settings-precedence">Exceptions to managed settings precedence</a>. Across managed sources the list never merges either; <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-settings#how-claude-code-combines-managed-sources">how Claude Code combines managed sources</a> says which source’s list applies. Across non-managed scopes Claude Code merges the arrays as usual.</li>
<li><a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#modelsettings"><code>modelSettings</code></a>: Claude Code resolves it one model at a time, together with <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#effortlevel"><code>effortLevel</code></a>. The <code>modelSettings</code> entry states which file’s value applies to a model.</li>
</ul>
<span id="examples"></span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="precedence-examples"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#precedence-examples">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Precedence examples</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">While Claude works, Claude Code shows a one-line tip under the spinner, such as “Use /config to change your default permission mode (including Plan Mode)”. Suppose you want those tips off, so you set <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#spinnertipsenabled"><code>spinnerTipsEnabled</code></a> to <code>false</code> in <code>~/.claude/settings.json</code>. Each scenario below is something that can turn them back on, and what you can do about it.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="team-settings-override-personal-settings"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#team-settings-override-personal-settings">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Team settings override personal settings</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">Your team’s <code>.claude/settings.json</code> sets it to <code>true</code>. Claude Code uses the project value because shared project sits above user, so you see tips in that project and nowhere else.</span>
<span data-as="p">You can get your value back: add <code>"spinnerTipsEnabled": false</code> to <code>.claude/settings.local.json</code> in that project. Project local sits above shared project, so your sessions there stop showing tips and your teammates’ sessions don’t change.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="organization-settings-override-everything"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#organization-settings-override-everything">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Organization settings override everything</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">Your organization’s managed settings set it to <code>true</code>. Nothing you put in user, project, or local settings turns tips off, and neither does <code>--settings</code>. Managed is the top level.</span>
<span data-as="p">You can’t get your value back. Run <code>/status</code> to see which managed source applies, and ask your administrator if the policy should change.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="the-command-line-overrides-your-files-for-one-session"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#the-command-line-overrides-your-files-for-one-session">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">The command line overrides your files for one session</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">You started the session with <code>claude --settings '{"spinnerTipsEnabled": true}'</code>. Command line sits above every file except managed, so that session shows tips even though your files say <code>false</code>.</span>
<span data-as="p">You get your value back on the next session; <code>--settings</code> lasts one session and doesn’t write to any file.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="a-flag-or-environment-variable-sets-the-same-thing"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#a-flag-or-environment-variable-sets-the-same-thing">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">A flag or environment variable sets the same thing</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">Some keys have a command line flag or an environment variable that overrides the settings value regardless of which file set it: <code>ANTHROPIC_MODEL</code> overrides the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#model"><code>model</code></a> setting, and <code>--model</code> overrides both for a session.</span>
<span data-as="p">Whether you can get your value back depends on the key: unset the variable or drop the flag, and check the key’s entry on the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference">settings reference</a> and the variable’s row on the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars">environment variables reference</a> for which one Claude Code uses.</span>
<span id="keys-ignored-in-a-repository-file"></span>
<span id="keys-only-you-or-your-organization-can-set"></span>
<span id="common-cases"></span>
<span id="which-value-applies-in-common-situations"></span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="troubleshoot-a-setting-that-doesn’t-apply"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#troubleshoot-a-setting-that-doesn’t-apply">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Troubleshoot a setting that doesn’t apply</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">When you set a key and Claude Code doesn’t behave as if you had, start with <code>/status</code> to see which files it loaded, then find your symptom below. <a class="link" href="/docs/en/debug-your-config">Debug your configuration</a> covers the wider checks, including a clean-configuration test.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="a-value-you-set-is-ignored"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#a-value-you-set-is-ignored">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">A value you set is ignored</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">Something else is setting the same key, the file can’t set that value, or the file didn’t load:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>A higher level sets it.</strong> Another settings file, a <code>--settings</code> flag, or a managed source sets the key above yours; the <a class="link" href="#settings-precedence">stack</a> says which. A flag or environment variable can also override the key on its own, decided key by key; the key’s entry on the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference">settings reference</a> says which one Claude Code uses, and the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#env"><code>env</code> entry</a> covers a managed <code>env</code> value versus a shell export.</li>
<li><strong>A security key keeps its strict value.</strong> For a few keys Claude Code honors the restrictive value from any file, so a project <code>true</code> for <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#disableclaudeaiconnectors"><code>disableClaudeAiConnectors</code></a> stays on; see <a class="link" href="#exceptions-to-managed-settings-precedence">Exceptions to managed settings precedence</a>.</li>
<li><strong>The file can’t set that value.</strong> <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#permissions-defaultmode"><code>permissions.defaultMode</code></a> values <code>auto</code> and <code>bypassPermissions</code> don’t take effect from project or local settings; set them in user or managed settings instead, or pass <code>--permission-mode</code> for one session. Before v2.1.257, <code>bypassPermissions</code> took effect from any file.</li>
<li><strong>The file is broken.</strong> Invalid JSON or a rejected value makes Claude Code skip the file or the entry; see <a class="link" href="#fix-a-broken-settings-file">Fix a broken settings file</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="a-change-you-made-in-claude-code-is-lost-in-new-sessions"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#a-change-you-made-in-claude-code-is-lost-in-new-sessions">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">A change you made in Claude Code is lost in new sessions</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">When you save a choice for new sessions from inside Claude Code, such as a default model with <code>/model</code>, Claude Code writes it to your user settings file, <code>~/.claude/settings.json</code>. If you can’t write to that file, for example because another tool generates it or links it to a read-only copy, the change applies to the current session and is gone in the next one. Set the key in the tool that generates the file, or replace the file with one you can write to.</span>
<span data-as="p">If you can write to the file and the change still doesn’t last, check whether the change was <a class="link" href="#change-a-setting-for-one-session">for one session only</a> or <a class="link" href="#a-value-you-set-is-ignored">a higher level sets the same key</a>. For the <code>model</code> key, <a class="link" href="/docs/en/model-config#a-new-session-starts-on-a-different-model-than-you-picked">A new session starts on a different model than you picked</a> lists more causes.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="a-managed-change-hasn’t-reached-you"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#a-managed-change-hasn’t-reached-you">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">A managed change hasn’t reached you</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">Managed sources reach a running session on the schedule in the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-settings#choose-a-delivery-mechanism">delivery table</a>, so restart the session first. If <code>/status</code> then names a different source than the one your administrator changed, a higher-priority source applies; <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-settings#how-claude-code-combines-managed-sources">How Claude Code combines managed sources</a> gives the order.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="a-committed-key-doesn’t-reach-teammates"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#a-committed-key-doesn’t-reach-teammates">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">A committed key doesn’t reach teammates</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">Two things keep a key in <code>.claude/settings.json</code> from applying for everyone who clones it:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Claude Code ignores the key in a repository file.</strong> Look for <code>User, local, or managed</code>, <code>User or managed</code>, <code>Managed</code>, or <code>Global config</code> in the Scope column of the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#settings-index">settings index</a>. Those keys never apply from the shared file, apart from a few that a repository file can still switch off. Each of those entries says so on its Scope line. <code>Global config</code> keys apply only from <code>~/.claude.json</code>.</li>
<li><strong>The key waits for trust.</strong> <code>permissions.allow</code> rules, <code>permissions.additionalDirectories</code>, <code>extraKnownMarketplaces</code>, and most <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#env"><code>env</code></a> values apply only after each teammate <a class="link" href="/docs/en/permissions#project-allow-rules-and-workspace-trust">trusts the folder</a>. Until then they still see prompts and don’t get plugins from a marketplace the file declares. <code>deny</code> and <code>ask</code> rules apply right away.</li>
</ul>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="permission-rules-combine-differently-than-you-expected"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#permission-rules-combine-differently-than-you-expected">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Permission rules combine differently than you expected</span></h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>You chose “Yes, and don’t ask again” on a permission prompt but still get prompted for the same tool.</strong> That choice saved an <code>allow</code> rule to your local file, and an <code>allow</code> rule there doesn’t outrank an <code>ask</code> rule from a project or managed file; <a class="link" href="/docs/en/permissions#settings-precedence">how permission rules combine</a> explains the order. In the VS Code extension the approval card lets you pick the destination file, including the project’s shared file, which changes the rule for everyone; in the CLI, Claude Code writes only to your local file.</li>
<li><strong>Your organization’s allow rules still apply alongside yours.</strong> That’s expected: Claude Code merges <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#permissions-allow"><code>permissions.allow</code></a> across scopes, unless your organization sets <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#allowmanagedpermissionrulesonly"><code>allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly</code></a>.</li>
</ul>
<span id="security-keys-where-the-stricter-value-applies"></span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="exceptions-to-managed-settings-precedence"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#exceptions-to-managed-settings-precedence">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Exceptions to managed settings precedence</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">For a few keys whose values restrict a session, Claude Code honors a restrictive value from a scope that otherwise couldn’t override managed settings. Find the key in this table to see which value it honors and from where.</span>

Requires Claude Code v2.1.242 or later</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#isolatepeermachines"><code>isolatePeerMachines</code></a></td><td style="text-align:left"><code>true</code> from any scope</td><td style="text-align:left">Honored even when a managed source sets <code>false</code></td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#remotecontrolatstartup"><code>remoteControlAtStartup</code></a></td><td style="text-align:left"><code>false</code> from <code>.claude/settings.json</code> or <code>.claude/settings.local.json</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Honored even when a managed source sets <code>true</code>; a project or local <code>true</code> is ignored</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#crosssessioninbound"><code>crossSessionInbound</code></a></td><td style="text-align:left">A stricter value from <code>.claude/settings.json</code> or <code>.claude/settings.local.json</code>, on the <code>accept</code> &lt; <code>hold</code> &lt; <code>refuse</code> ladder</td><td style="text-align:left">Honored over managed, <code>--settings</code>, and user values; a project or local value that isn’t stricter is ignored</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#useautomodeduringplan"><code>useAutoModeDuringPlan</code></a></td><td style="text-align:left"><code>false</code> from any managed source, <code>--settings</code>, <code>~/.claude/settings.json</code>, or <code>.claude/settings.local.json</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Honored even when the winning managed source sets <code>true</code>; a <code>false</code> in <code>.claude/settings.json</code> is ignored</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#syncclaudeaiskills"><code>syncClaudeAiSkills</code></a></td><td style="text-align:left"><code>false</code> from any managed source, <code>--settings</code>, <code>~/.claude/settings.json</code>, or <code>.claude/settings.local.json</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Honored even when the winning managed source sets <code>true</code>; a <code>false</code> in <code>.claude/settings.json</code> is ignored</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#maxeffortlevel"><code>maxEffortLevel</code></a></td><td style="text-align:left">A lower cap from any scope, including <code>--settings</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Honored even when the managed settings Claude Code applies set a higher cap; the lowest cap applies. Requires Claude Code v2.1.267 or later</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></div>
<span data-as="p">An app that runs Claude Code inside itself and sets <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST</code></a> is also an exception. Claude Code takes that app’s model configuration over the <code>model</code>, <code>fallbackModel</code>, <code>modelPicker</code>, and <code>modelOverrides</code> keys from every managed source, and over the model-selection variables in a managed <code>env</code> block, such as <code>ANTHROPIC_MODEL</code> and the <code>ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL</code> family. Claude Code keeps a managed <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#availablemodels"><code>availableModels</code></a> allowlist in force unless the app supplies its own.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="settings-in-cloud-sessions"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#settings-in-cloud-sessions">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Settings in cloud sessions</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">A <a class="link" href="/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web">cloud session</a> runs in a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/cloud-environments">cloud environment</a> on a fresh clone of your repository, not on your machine. That changes which settings reach it:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Shared project settings</strong> (<code>.claude/settings.json</code>): read, because the file is part of the clone. Commit a setting there to apply it in cloud sessions.</li>
<li><strong>User and project local settings</strong> (<code>~/.claude/settings.json</code> and <code>.claude/settings.local.json</code>): not read. Both stay on your machine, and the local file isn’t in the clone.</li>
<li><strong>Managed settings</strong>: only <a class="link" href="/docs/en/server-managed-settings">server-managed settings</a> reach a cloud session; a <code>managed-settings.json</code> file or MDM profile on your device doesn’t. A <a class="link" href="/docs/en/self-hosted-environments">self-hosted environment</a> also reads the managed settings file in its runner image. <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-settings#how-claude-code-combines-managed-sources">How Claude Code combines managed sources</a> says when that file applies.</li>
<li><strong><code>/config</code></strong>: in your browser at claude.ai/code, opens the Claude Code section of your claude.ai settings instead of changing a value. To change a setting for a cloud session, set an <a class="link" href="/docs/en/cloud-environments#set-environment-variables">environment variable</a> on the environment or commit the key to the repository’s <code>.claude/settings.json</code>.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p"><a class="link" href="/docs/en/cloud-environments#what-carries-over-from-your-setup">What carries over from your setup</a> lists the rest: <code>CLAUDE.md</code>, skills, MCP servers, plugins, and credentials.</span>
